target.title: fix(agents): preserve ANSI sanitizer state across bash chunks
target.body:
Closes #103668

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users running bash commands through agents could see ANSI/OSC control-sequence fragments leak into streamed tool output, final bash results, and full-output spill files when a process split a terminal sequence across output callbacks.

## Why This Change Was Made

The fix adds a reusable incremental ANSI sequence stripper in terminal-core and lets the bash output accumulator use one sanitizer instance for the lifetime of each command. This preserves streaming and bounded-memory behavior while keeping one-shot `stripAnsiSequences()` semantics unchanged for existing callers.

## User Impact

Bash output sanitization is now invariant to callback chunking for OSC and CSI sequences. Agents and users receive the same clean output whether the process emits a complete sequence in one callback or splits it across callbacks.

## Evidence

Before this patch, sanitizing `A\x1b]0;title` and `\x07B` independently leaked fragments such as `Aitle\x07B`; whole-input sanitization returned `AB`.

Focused regression proof on this branch:

```text
$ PATH="/Users/xjch/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/node/bin:$PATH" node scripts/run-vitest.mjs packages/terminal-core/src/ansi.test.ts src/agents/sessions/tools/output-accumulator.test.ts src/agents/sessions/bash-executor.test.ts
[test] starting test/vitest/vitest.unit-fast.config.ts

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  22 passed (22)

[test] starting test/vitest/vitest.agents.config.ts

 Test Files  2 passed (2)
      Tests  9 passed (9)

[test] passed 2 Vitest shards in 12.60s
```

Additional validation:

```text
$ PATH="/Users/xjch/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/node/bin:$PATH" node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs packages/terminal-core/src/ansi.ts packages/terminal-core/src/ansi.test.ts src/agents/sessions/tools/output-accumulator.ts src/agents/sessions/tools/output-accumulator.test.ts src/agents/sessions/bash-executor.ts src/agents/sessions/bash-executor.test.ts
# passed

$ git diff --check
# passed
```

The new tests cover:

- terminal-core incremental stripping for split ESC OSC, C1 OSC, ESC CSI, and C1 CSI sequences;
- `OutputAccumulator.finish()` flushing stateful transforms;
- the real `executeBashWithOperations()` path proving streamed chunks and final output are `ABCDEFGH` for split ANSI/OSC chunks;
- spilled full-output files preserving the sanitized `AB\n` output when split OSC data exceeds the truncation threshold.
